title.fa: ایران معاصر: از مشروطه تا امروز
title.en: Modern Iran: from the Constitutional Revolution to today
title.nl: Modern Iran: van de Constitutionele Revolutie tot nu

summary.fa: صد و بیست سال کشاکش بر سر یک پرسش: قدرت را چگونه می‌شود به قانون و رأی مردم بست؟ از مشروطه (۱۲۸۵) و ملی‌شدن نفت تا انقلاب ۱۳۵۷، جنگ هشت‌ساله و موج‌های اعتراض ۱۳۸۸، ۱۳۹۸ و ۱۴۰۱.
summary.en: A hundred and twenty years of struggle over one question: how can power be bound to law and the popular vote? From the Constitutional Revolution (1906) and oil nationalisation to the 1979 revolution, the eight-year war and the protest waves of 2009, 2019 and 2022.
summary.nl: A hundred and twenty years of struggle over one question: how can power be bound to law and the popular vote? From the Constitutional Revolution (1906) and oil nationalisation to the 1979 revolution, the eight-year war and the protest waves of 2009, 2019 and 2022.
